description: This file defines models and a fetcher class for Cboe available indices, including query parameters, data structure, and data fetching logic.

classes.name: CboeAvailableIndicesQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for fetching Cboe available indices, including cache control.

classes.name: CboeAvailableIndicesData
classes.description: Represents data for a Cboe available index, including symbol, description, trading times, and other metadata.

classes.name: CboeAvailableIndicesFetcher
classes.description: Handles fetching and transforming Cboe index data from the endpoint.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a CboeAvailableIndicesQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches raw index data from the Cboe endpoint.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw data into a list of CboeAvailableIndicesData instances.
